label: McCombs School of Business internal transfer (BBA)
cycle: 2026-27: application opens September 15, 2026; deadline December 1, 2026, 11:59 p.m. CT; decisions in early January
applyWithin: Apply within your first four long semesters at UT Austin.
residenceNote: At least 24 hours in residence at UT Austin. Credit by exam, correspondence, extension, pass/fail, PED and transfer hours (including ACC) do not count toward the in-residence requirement.
gpa: A 3.25 in-residence UT GPA is the minimum to apply; admitted internal transfers averaged about 3.88 (Fall 2026) and 3.84 (Spring 2026). Only UT courses count toward the in-residence GPA.
outsideCoursework: For the Spring 2027 cycle, only prerequisite coursework taken at UT Austin is considered if it is not finished by December 1; in-progress outside prerequisites are not accepted. For Fall 2027, in-progress prerequisite coursework from outside institutions is permitted. The page does not say how completed outside prerequisites are weighed; confirm with McCombs advising.
competitive: Highly competitive; McCombs advises not to enroll elsewhere at UT assuming a transfer. Students with 90+ hours are encouraged to consider other options.
